note: §6: a term that ends between `resolve` and `record`. The lock re-checks every visited term against `ts(s)` — the second-truncated instant the log is about to write — so the recorded position and the term it claims to be inside agree. `eventTs` pins that: the denial event carries exactly the instant the re-check compared against, which is the whole content of the sentence and was not true until contract r4.3 said `ts(s)` is the truncated one.
